shortDescription: Manages Pritunl Organizations using the Pritunl API

options.name: force
options.description: If O(force) is V(true) and O(state) is V(absent), the module deletes the organization, no matter if it contains users or not. By default O(force) is V(false), which causes the module to fail the deletion of the organization when it contains users.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the organization to manage in Pritunl.

options.name: pritunl_api_secret
options.description: API Secret found in Administrators > USERNAME > API Secret.

options.name: pritunl_api_token
options.description: API Token of a Pritunl admin user. It needs to be enabled in Administrators > USERNAME > Enable Token Authentication.

options.name: pritunl_url
options.description: URL and port of the Pritunl server on which the API is enabled.

options.name: state
options.description: If V(present), the module adds organization O(name) to Pritunl. If V(absent), attempt to delete the organization from Pritunl (please read about O(force) usage).

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If certificates should be validated or not. This should never be set to V(false), except if you are very sure that your connection to the server can not be subject to a Man In The Middle attack.
